dedupe_keys.name: macau food safety information iam food incident monitoring criteria database and risk study reports

description: The Food Safety Centre of Macau's Municipal Affairs Bureau (IAM) runs the food safety information site. Pages read on 2026-09-29 offer a table of food incident monitoring reports, a searchable database of Macau's food safety criteria, food consumption data, reports on analyses of specific foodstuffs and risk assessment studies, alerts, and guidance for the trade, together with the licensing and registration procedures for importers and retailers of fresh and live food. Coverage: Macau Special Administrative Region, China. Format and access: free web tables and PDF reports on iam.gov.mo. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the monitoring reports are summaries of incidents and sampling, not a machine-readable series; the older address foodsafety.gov.mo no longer answers. Simulation uses: context for food supply disruption and emergency response studies in a city that imports most of its food. Related records: compare with the Athens central market statistics (data-okaa-athens-central-market-statistics) and the COMSES food safety inspection model (model-comses-food-safety-inspection-model).
